pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions in the direction of a running drawdown; all scaling must occur strictly in-profit via trailing limit entries.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero new order execution within 5 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic tier-1 prints and mandatory ATR-based volatility cap.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing locks as soon as open profit hits +$10.00 to prevent positive drift evaporation.
